§6Bedrock Ore Processor§f

§aAlso known as the ore slopper  -  splits raw bedrock ore into six categories for further processing!§f

The §bBedrock Ore Processor§f takes raw bedrock ore from your Large Mining Drill and sorts it into six types: §bLight Metal§f, §bHeavy Metal§f, §bRare Earth§f, §bActinide§f, §bNon-Metal§f, and §bCrystalline§f. The mix depends on the vein composition.

§6Crafting§f (Assembly Machine):
§b•§f 6x Cast Steel Plate, 8x Titanium Plate, 3x Copper Pipe
§b•§f 3x Motor, 1x Analog Circuit Board

§6Operation§f:
§b•§f Feed raw ore through any fluid port.
§b•§f Needs water and power to run.
§b•§f Outputs six ore types plus §bOre Slop§f as a byproduct.

§6Ore Slop§f can go into an §bElectrolysis Machine§f for Mercury, Niter, Limestone Dust, and Sulfur.

§ePS:§f All six ore types follow the same downstream processing chain. One set of machines handles everything!
